title: A 0.5B speech model is open. The scores are the maker's.
friendlyTitle: A small open speech model is out. The scores are the maker's.
summary: Reson8 released Rumble-2-Flash on 18 November under Apache 2.0, a 0.5-billion-parameter speech model for more than 40 languages. It runs in Hugging Face Transformers and vLLM without custom code. The weights are at Reson8/Rumble-2-Flash.
friendlySummary: On 18 November, Reson8 released Rumble-2-Flash under a free Apache 2.0 license. It has 0.5 billion parameters and covers more than 40 languages. It runs in common Hugging Face tools without custom code. The weights are at Reson8/Rumble-2-Flash.
whyItMatters: Reson8 says it averages a 6.96 percent error rate on one multilingual leaderboard and 7.86 percent on a 302-hour call-centre set, about even with a 30-billion-parameter NVIDIA model on that set. Those are the maker's tests. Check a name, a number, or a dose before you trust the transcript.
